Schedule defaults to Mon/Tue/Thu/Sat training, with optional easy cardio/mobility on other days. Global guidelines
- RPE targets: Main lifts RPE 6–8 (top sets to RPE 8 outside flow/flare in Phase 2), accessories RPE 7–8. Exhale on exertion; avoid breath holds.
- Warm-up (8–10 min): easy cardio 3–5 min, mobility (cat-cow, 90/90, open books, world’s greatest), activation (glute bridge 2x10, dead bug 2x6/side, band pull-aparts 2x12), 360-breathing.
- Core focus: dead bug, heel slides, side plank, Pallof press, bird dog, light carries; avoid heavy planks/carries on symptom days.
- Cardio anchors: Zone 2 base most days; intervals/tempos only outside flow/flare. Progress weekly Zone 2 minutes by ~10–15% if recovered.
- Substitutions on flow/flare: use box squats, hip thrusts/KB deadlift from blocks, incline/landmine press, supported rows; shorten ROM; swap all intervals/plyo for easy Zone 2.

PHASE 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1–4: Jun 1–28)
Goal: Movement quality, base strength, mobility, aerobic foundation. Mostly RPE 6–7; no HIIT.

Week 1
- Mon Lower + core + Z2: Goblet squat 3x8; DB RDL 3x8; split squat 3x6/side; side plank 2x20–30s; Pallof 2x10/side; Zone 2 15–20 min.
- Tue Upper + mobility: Incline DB press 3x8; 1-arm DB row 3x10/side; seated/half-kneel OHP 3x8; lat pulldown 3x10; face pulls 2x12–15; thoracic mobility 5–7 min.
- Thu Full-body + core: KB deadlift from blocks 3x8; step-up 3x8/side; push-up 3x8–10; bird dog 2x8/side; light farmer carry 3x20–30 m.
- Sat Cardio + mobility: MISS 25–30 min (RPE 5–6); hip openers 8–10 min.

- Tue: DB bench 3x8–10; chest-supported row 3x10; seated DB OHP 3x8; pulldown 3x10; face pulls 2x15.
- Thu: Trap-bar DL light 3x6–8 (or KB DL); goblet squat 3x8; anti-rotation walkout 3x8/side; push-up 3x8–12; carry 3x30 m.
- Sat: MISS 30–35 min + 10 min gentle yoga.

- Tue: Incline DB press 4x6–8; 1-arm cable row 4x8/side; half-kneel press 3x8/side; pulldown 3x8–10; face pulls 3x12–15.

  - Work to a smooth top set at RPE 9 for 3–5 reps on goblet/front squat pattern, trap-bar deadlift, DB bench, and chest-supported row. Exhale on exertion; no grinding.
  - Use standard E1RM formulas (e.g., Epley: load x [1 + reps/30]) to estimate 1RM.
- “AMRAP with RIR” sets
  - Choose a known training load from Week 9–10 and perform max reps leaving 1–2 reps in reserve (RPE 8–9). Convert to E1RM with rep charts; compare to prior weeks for progress.
- Velocity-based or tempo-constrained testing (if tools available)
  - Use a linear transducer or bar-velocity app on submax sets to project 1RM without max effort.
- Isometric mid-thigh pull or dynamometer testing (if available)
  - High reliability with lower intra-abdominal pressure than heavy free-weight 1RM.

- Schedule: Test on a green-light week, 4–6 days away from any flare/flow; skip if symptomatic, bloated, or sleep-deprived.
- Warm-up: Gradual wave loading (e.g., 5–6 sets of 3–5 reps increasing to the top set), never hold breath; 2–3 min rests.
- Stop rule: End the set if form deteriorates, you sense the need to Valsalva, or RPE >9. No grinders.
- Exercise selections: Favor goblet/front squat, trap-bar deadlift from high handles/blocks, DB bench, chest-supported row, landmine press—stable, supportive patterns.
- Spotters/equipment: Use spotter/rails where appropriate; prioritize safety over numbers.

  - Work up to a single rep that moves fast and clean, with continuous exhale on the concentric. This provides a performance snapshot with far less strain than a true 1RM.
  - Follow with 2–3 back-off sets at −10–12% for quality volume.

Bottom line
- Avoid true 1RM. Use 3–5RM or an RPE 8–9 technical single to estimate 1RM and track progress while honoring her no-heavy-Valsalva constraint and minimizing symptom risk.

- Cardio anchors: Zone 2 base most days; intervals/tempos only outside flow/flare. Progress weekly Zone 2 minutes by ~10–15% if recovered.
- Substitutions on flow/flare: use box squats, hip thrusts/KB deadlift from blocks, incline/landmine press, supported rows; shorten ROM; swap all intervals/plyo for easy Zone 2.

PHASE 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1–4: Jun 1–28)
Goal: Movement quality, base strength, mobility, aerobic foundation. Mostly RPE 6–7; no HIIT.

Week 1
- Mon Lower + core + Z2: Goblet squat 3x8; DB RDL 3x8; split squat 3x6/side; side plank 2x20–30s; Pallof 2x10/side; Zone 2 15–20 min.
- Tue Upper + mobility: Incline DB press 3x8; 1-arm DB row 3x10/side; seated/half-kneel OHP 3x8; lat pulldown 3x10; face pulls 2x12–15; thoracic mobility 5–7 min.
- Thu Full-body + core: KB deadlift from blocks 3x8; step-up 3x8/side; push-up 3x8–10; bird dog 2x8/side; light farmer carry 3x20–30 m.
- Sat Cardio + mobility: MISS 25–30 min (RPE 5–6); hip openers 8–10 min.

Week 2
- Progress load/reps 2–5% if RPE ≤7.
- Mon: Front-foot elevated split squat 3x8/side; DB RDL 3x8–10; loaded glute bridge 3x10; side plank 3x20–30s; Pallof 3x10/side; Z2 15–20 min.
- Tue: DB bench 3x8–10; chest-supported row 3x10; seated DB OHP 3x8; pulldown 3x10; face pulls 2x15.
- Thu: Trap-bar DL light 3x6–8 (or KB DL); goblet squat 3x8; anti-rotation walkout 3x8/side; push-up 3x8–12; carry 3x30 m.
- Sat: MISS 30–35 min + 10 min gentle yoga.

Week 3
- Mon: Goblet squat 4x6–8; DB RDL 4x8; reverse lunge 3x8/side; side plank 3x30–40s; dead bug 3x6/side; Z2 15–20 min.
- Tue: Incline DB press 4x6–8; 1-arm cable row 4x8/side; half-kneel press 3x8/side; pulldown 3x8–10; face pulls 3x12–15.
- Thu: Trap-bar DL 4x5–6 (RPE 7); step-up 3x8/side; push-up 3x10–12; Pallof 3x10/side; carry 3x30–40 m.
- Sat: MISS 30–35 min + 10 min mobility.

Week 4 (Deload; possible flow late week)
- Keep RPE ≤6, reduce volume ~30–40%.
- Mon: Goblet squat 3x6; DB RDL 3x6; split squat 2x6/side; side plank 2x20s; Z2 10–15 min.
- Tue: DB press 3x6; row 3x8; band pull-aparts 2x15; mobility 10 min.
- Thu: KB deadlift 3x6; step-up 2x6/side; Pallof 2x10/side.
- Sat: Easy Z2 walk 20–25 min.

PHASE 2 — Intensified Build (Weeks 5–8: Jun 29–Jul 26)
Goal: Faster strength gains, higher aerobic stimulus. Top sets to RPE 8 with back-offs; strong MISS/intervals on green days. Flare Jul 10–13; flow likely Jul 25–28.

Week 5 (early flow possible; push once clear)
- Mon Lower: Front squat pattern top set 1x5 @ RPE 8; back-offs 3x5 @ −10%; trap-bar DL 1x4 @ 8 + 3x4 @ −8–10%; walking lunge 3x10/side @ RPE 8; side plank 3x35–45s; optional incline walk 6–8 min.
- Tue Upper: DB bench 1x6 @ 8 + 3x6 back-offs; chest-supported row 4x8 @ 8; seated DB OHP 3x8; pulldown 3x8–10; face pulls 3x15.
- Thu Full-body: If symptom-free, KB swing 4x12 @ RPE 7; else RDL 4x8 @ RPE 7. Step-up 4x10/side @ 8; push-up 4x10–12 @ 8; Pallof 3x12/side; suitcase carry 3x30–40 m.
- Sat Cardio: Intervals 8x60s @ RPE 8, 75–90s easy; 8–10 min Z2 warm-up/cool-down. If still on flow: Z2 30–35 min.
- Cardio add-ons: Post-lift Z2 25–30 min Mon/Thu if energy good.

Week 6 (push early; deload during flare Jul 10–13)
- Mon Lower: Front squat 1x4 @ 8 + 3x4 back-offs; trap-bar DL 1x3 @ 8 + 3x3; reverse lunge 4x8/side @ 8; dead bug 3x6/side.
- Tue Upper: Incline DB press 1x5 @ 8 + 3x5; 1-arm row 4x8/side @ 8; landmine or seated OHP 3x8; face pulls 3x15.
- Thu (flare, deload): Box squat 3x6 light; hip thrust 3x8 light; Pallof 2x10/side; side plank 2x20–30s; easy walk 15–20 min.
- Sat (flare): Z2 20–30 min easy + 10–15 min mobility.
- Cardio early week: Mon post-lift Z2 25–30 min; Tue MISS 25–30 min if no flare signs.

Week 7 (post-flare strongest week)
- Mon Lower: Front squat 1x3 @ 8 + 3x3; RDL 4x6 @ 8; step-up 4x10/side @ 8; side plank 3x40–50s.
- Tue Upper: DB bench 1x5 @ 8 + 3x5; chest-supported row 4x8–10 @ 8; half-kneel press 3x8/side @ 8; pulldown 3x8–10.
- Thu Full-body: Trap-bar DL 1x3 @ 8 + 4x2–3 crisp back-offs; Bulgarian split squat 3x8/side @ 8; push-up 4x10–12; Pallof 3x12/side.
- Sat Cardio: Intervals 10x60s @ RPE 8, 60–75s easy + Z2 warm-up/cool-down. Optional Sun LSD 45–60 min low Z2 if recovered.

Week 8 (keep intensity; taper if pre-flow Jul 25–28)
- Mon Lower: Goblet/front squat 1x4 @ 8 + 3x4; trap-bar DL 1x3 @ 8 + 3x3; walking lunge 4x10/side @ 8; dead bug 3x6/side.
- Tue Upper: Incline DB press 1x5 @ 8 + 3x5; 1-arm cable row 4x8/side @ 8; seated OHP 3x8; face pulls 3x15.
- Thu Full-body: Hip thrust 4x6–8 @ 8 (or 3x6 @ RPE 6–7 if pre-flow); step-up 3–4x10/side @ 8 (or 2–3x8 light); push-up 3–4x10–12; Pallof 3x12/side.
- Sat Cardio: If not in flow, mixed intervals 8–10x45–60s @ RPE 8; if in flow, Z2 25–35 min.

PHASE 3 — Consolidate & Condition (Weeks 9–12: Jul 27–Aug 23)
Goal: Solidify strength, sustain aerobic base, manage Aug 4–7 flare and late-cycle flow. Testing uses submax methods; avoid true 1RM.

Week 9
- Mon Lower: Front squat 4x5 @ RPE 7–8; trap-bar DL 4x3–4 @ 7–8; lateral lunge 3x6/side; side plank 3x30–40s.
- Tue Upper: DB bench 4x6; chest-supported row 4x8; landmine press 3x8/side; pulldown 3x8–10; face pulls 3x12–15.
- Thu Full-body: Hip thrust 4x6–8 @ 7; step-up 3x8–10/side; push-up 4x10–12; Pallof 3x10/side.
- Sat Cardio: Mixed intervals 6x90s @ RPE 7–8 + Z2 warm-up/cool-down or MISS 35–40 min.

Week 10 (flare Aug 4–7; deload midweek)
- Mon (pre-flare): Goblet squat 3x6; RDL 3x6; reverse lunge 2–3x6/side; dead bug 2x6/side; Z2 25–30 min.
- Tue–Thu (flare, choose 2 light sessions):
  - Option A: Mobility 10–15 min + Z2 15–25 min + heat.
  - Option B: Box squat 2–3x6 light; hip thrust 2–3x8 light; seated/band row 2–3x10; Pallof 2x10/side; side plank 2x20s/side.
- Sat (post-flare): MISS 25–30 min or Z2 30–40 min if good.

Week 11 (rebuild)
- Mon: Front squat 4x5 @ 7; trap-bar DL 3x3–4 @ 7–8; step-up 3x8–10/side; side plank 3x30–40s.
- Tue: DB bench 4x6–8; chest-supported row 4x8–10; seated OHP 3x8; face pulls 3x12–15.
- Thu: Hip thrust 4x6–8; lateral lunge 3x6/side; push-up 4x10–12; Pallof 3x10/side.
- Sat: Intervals 8x60s @ RPE 7–8 + Z2 warm-up/cool-down or MISS 35 min.

Week 12 (taper; flow likely Aug 21–24)
- Mon: Goblet/front squat 3x5 moderate; RDL 3x6; reverse lunge 3x6/side; dead bug 2x6/side; Z2 30–35 min if fresh.
- Tue: DB bench 3x6–8; 1-arm row 3x8/side; landmine/seated OHP 2–3x8 light-moderate; face pulls 2x12–15.
- Thu (pre-flow deload): Step-up 2–3x8/side; hip thrust 2–3x8; push-up 2–3x8–10; Pallof 2x10/side.
- Sat (likely in flow): Easy Z2 20–30 min or rest; mobility 10–15 min, heat as needed.
- Optional strength check (early week, not during flow/flare): Choose 1–2 lifts and perform either a 3–5RM at RPE 9 with continuous exhale (estimate 1RM via Epley) or a technical single at RPE 8–9, then −10% back-offs. No grinders, no breath holds.

Aerobic base plan (weekly minutes and key sessions)
- Phase 1 weekly Zone 2/MISS: 75–140 min; primarily Z2 with one MISS day.
- Phase 2 weekly Zone 2/MISS: 140–200 min; add intervals RPE 8 on green days (Weeks 5, 7, 8), deload during Week 6 flare.
- Phase 3 weekly Zone 2/MISS: 160–230 min; one LSD 60–80 min most weeks (skip/delay during flare/flow); intervals modest intensity outside flare/flow.

“Metcon/power without jumping” option (green days, replace Sat intervals when desired)
- Bike-based power surges: 2–3 rounds of 6x30s @ RPE 8, 60s easy; 3 min Z2 between rounds.
- Medicine-ball non-impact throws: tall-kneel chest pass 4x6–8; half-kneel rotational toss 4x6/side.
- Keep seated, no maximal sprints; avoid during flow/flare.

Anti-inflammatory nutrition (daily framework)
- Protein 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day; distribute over 3–4 meals.
- Carbs: complex, higher on training days; moderate on rest; pre-workout carb-rich meal 2–3 h prior; 20–40 g protein + 30–60 g carbs post.
- Fats: 30–40% kcal, emphasize EVOO, avocado, nuts/seeds; fish 2–3x/week or EPA/DHA 1–2 g/day if cleared.
- Plants: 5+ servings veg/day; berries/citrus daily; spices (turmeric+pepper, ginger).
- Fiber: 25–35 g/day; moderate if bloated.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day + 300–500 ml around training; herbal teas for comfort.
- Flow/flare meals: warm, easy-to-digest soups/stews; steady carbs; limit big bean portions, carbonation, very spicy/fatty meals; prioritize iron-rich foods around flow if needed.

Recovery and symptom management
- Sleep 7–9 h; heat therapy 15–20 min for cramps; 10–20 min gentle mobility on rest/flow/flare days.
- Auto-modify any day with pain ≥6/10, high bloat, or poor sleep: cut volume 50%, cap RPE ≤6, choose supported positions, prefer Z2 walking/cycling.
- Track daily pain, energy, sleep, and exercise responses; substitute patterns that feel better (e.g., pull-throughs for hinges, leg press for squats) while keeping the stimulus similar.

This summary provides the week-by-week structure, intensified middle phase, aerobic base development, anti-inflammatory nutrition, and all flow/flare safeguards so you can coach day-to-day with confidence. Adjust dates/reps in real time based on symptoms and readiness.
